title: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM) – health-access infrastructure Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: National digital health infrastructure supporting interoperable health records, health IDs and digital discovery of healthcare services; it is not itself an insurance policy.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Open to citizens/users participating in the digital health ecosystem according to current ABDM rules; insurance eligibility is determined separately by schemes such as PM-JAY.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM) – health-access infrastructure.

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
